all.text: An invite from your friend
Your friend saved you a Shiney Ticket . Four free classes in two weeks. Train with the friend who invited you.
For a member and a new adult guest. Ask Sandy to set the class first.
The Shiney Ticket
A member's invite. A coached start.
Your two-week start
Sandy confirms each class and space. Ask to train with your friend. Sandy matches each pair.
Ask for a time that suits you both. Meet Sandy and see the room first.
Sandy starts your pass at your first class. That class counts as one of four. Use all four by the end of day 14. Sandy gives you the end date.
Use your next three classes within that time. Then choose if you want to join.
Your pace. Your choice.
Meet Sandy for your first visit. Then choose to train that day or come back for class. Sandy confirms the plan with you.
For a visit, wear your own day clothes. To train, wear clean sports clothes. Follow Sandy's class and arrival plan.
Sparring is live practice with a partner. You can choose to try it on day one. Sandy matches the partner and pace. You can pause or end a round at any time.

Try a timed round with Sandy. A belt holds his arms at his sides. He uses movement to defend. You both agree on rules first. Either of you can say "pause" to end the round. Sandy releases the belt when the round ends. You choose if you take part.
Your invite starts here
Fill this out with your friend. Sandy will text to set the class.
Tapping or scanning your card opens this page. Your pass starts when you attend class.
6045 Main Street, 2nd Floor Tannersville, NY 12485
For a first-time adult guest, age 18 or up.
Sandy confirms each class by text. Fill out your waiver before you train.
Sandy will text you. He will set the class and when to arrive. He will send your waiver. Wait for his reply first.
Your pass starts at your first class. Sandy will give you the end date.
For the member who shares
Your friend joins their first 12-week plan. Their first payment clears. You earn $35 to use at the school.
Use it for gear, events, or your account.
One reward per new guest who joins.
You can use it at the school. It has no cash value.
This gift is for friends. It does not cover your close family.
Use our base rates with this credit. It does not stack with our rates for those who serve the public.
Each free class needs space and Sandy's OK. Your friend needs to be new and age 18 or up. Day one is your first attended class. All four classes must end by day 14.
Train in Tannersville with a friend. We serve Hunter and Windham too. Friends from Haines Falls and the Catskills can join.
